instruction: Configure Thunderbird to compact folders automatically when the potential disk space savings exceed 1000 KB.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Thunderbird to automatically compact folders when it will save over 1000 KB. This is done by setting the mail.purge_threshold_mb preference to 1 (since the preference uses MB units and 1000 KB ≈ 1 MB). The evaluator uses the existing check_thunderbird_prefs function to verify this preference value in the prefs.js file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: 1000 KB ≈ 1 MB, and mail.purge_threshold_mb is set to 1
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses prefs.js and compares preference values using 'eq' method
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is saved before verification
Expected value semantics are correct: ref=1 for mail.purge_threshold_mb matches the instruction's 1000 KB requirement
Getter get_vm_file correctly retrieves the prefs.js file from the VM to local cache for metric evaluation
Metric handles None result gracefully (returns 0.0 if file retrieval fails)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider adding a preference check for 'mail.prompt_purge_threshold' to verify auto-compact is enabled (not just threshold set), though current check may be sufficient depending on Thunderbird defaults

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
